newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse eases marginally in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse eases marginally in moderate trade.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index eased marginally on Thursday in a moderate trading session, bourse officials said.
The index shed 8.75 points to close at 3470.53. Turnover was posted at 17.2 million shillings on 323,202 shares compared to 21.8 million shillings on 333,763 shares on Wednesday.
Bourse officials said the day's trading session was dull and slow.
Brokers however, were optimistic about the market saying the it only appeared to be in a lull when compared to activity in January.
"But actually, this time last year, the market was more depressed," a senior broker said.
Another broker added that jitters about the forth-coming general elections scheduled for later this year had slowed down market activity.
"You know a lot of people are still undecided about whether to buy now because of the elections," he said. Brooke Bond eased to 124 from 125 while Rea Vipingo closed at 8.80 from 9.
Uchumi Supermarket shed 50 cents to close at 46.25. Barclays Bank eased a shilling to close at 114 while Standard Chartered Bank edged by 50 cents to close at 46.50.
Foreign investors traded Kenya Power & Lighting at 172 from 173, Firestone East Africa at 30 unchanged and Kenya Commercial Bank at between 95.50 and 96 from 95.50.
